description: In front of you on the wooden table is a partially built wall of large, colorful soft LEGO-like blocks, with several loose blocks piled behind it. The left hand reaches forward to pick up a light blue block from the loose pile, brings it down and presses it onto the left side of the wall, then grabs a green block and stacks it on top; the right hand stays near the right end of the wall, hovering and lightly steadying the structure while the left hand aligns and releases each block.
